photos.title: Coquina Harbour and Lightkeepers Village slips from above, NAIP aerial, April 2023
photos.what: One long marina basin off the Intracoastal Waterway in Little River from straight above on April 10, 2023, full of boats in rows of slips: Coquina Harbour's slips in its upper part, Lightkeepers Village's near its mouth. Condo buildings line both sides, US 17 crosses the top left corner, a golf course is at the upper right, and the wide waterway and marsh are across the bottom. Labels: US 17, Coquina Harbour, Lightkeepers Village, Intracoastal Waterway.
photos.caption: Coquina Harbour and Lightkeepers Village share one basin between US 17 and the waterway.
photos.alt: A marina basin full of boats off the Intracoastal Waterway, from above, with Coquina Harbour labelled at its upper end, Lightkeepers Village near its mouth, US 17 at the top left and a golf course at the upper right

place.sublocation: Coquina Harbour and Lightkeepers Village, on the Intracoastal Waterway

photos.title: The Cherry Grove channels from above, NAIP aerial, April 2023
photos.what: Cherry Grove in North Myrtle Beach from straight above: rows of houses on long finger lots between dug channels, most with a dock behind the house; the open marsh and its creeks to the north-west; the city boat ramp's lot on the marsh; the Heritage Shores island at the top right; Ocean Boulevard, the beach and the ocean along the bottom. Labels: Boat ramp, Heritage Shores, Channel houses, Atlantic Ocean.
photos.caption: Houses on the Cherry Grove channels, many with a dock behind them, the marsh, the boat ramp and Heritage Shores, from above.
photos.alt: Cherry Grove from above: rows of houses on narrow lots between dug channels, with docks behind them, the marsh beyond, and the ocean along the bottom, labelled Boat ramp, Heritage Shores, Channel houses and Atlantic Ocean

place.sublocation: The Cherry Grove channels and marsh

photos.title: The old Socastee swing bridge, from above
photos.what: Straight down on the Intracoastal Waterway at Socastee on 2023 NAIP imagery: the old steel truss swing bridge, painted blue, carries a two-lane road across the waterway in the middle; a newer four-lane highway bridge crosses at the lower left; houses on a curving street at the upper left, woods along both banks, a small dock and boat landing below the old bridge.
photos.caption: The old Socastee swing bridge, the blue steel span, on the Intracoastal Waterway, with the newer highway bridge at the lower left.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of a blue steel truss swing bridge carrying a two-lane road over the Intracoastal Waterway at Socastee, with a newer four-lane bridge at the lower left and houses at the upper left

place.sublocation: Old Socastee Swing Span (S-616, old SC 544), Socastee
